text:
maria: Heads-up — AtlasHealth (top-5) just escalated. They want Private deployment + Dedicated capacity committed for an Aug 15 ship. Key asks: VPC peering, KMS/HSM integration, model pinning, 500 req/s sustained, p95 <200ms. They expect SLA (99.99) and audit logs. Can product commit to scope/date? @anya @dave
anya: Thanks. Quick reality check: Q3 roadmap is packed but this is high ARR. We should avoid overpromising. Proposal: staged delivery — (1) Dedicated capacity + VPC + model pinning (MVP), (2) KMS/HSM + full SLA + audit in next release. Need acceptance criteria and a clear canary plan.
dave: Staged makes sense. Engineering constraints: to hit p95 <200ms for their load we need benchmarking on the dedicated pool (GPUs TBD). Earliest realistic MVP is ~8w from kickoff if we can re-prioritize infra tasks. KMS/HSM adds another 4-6w and compliance testing.
tom: FYI infra checklist: network peering template, RBAC for private control plane, audit log export. Also need ticket for HSM vendor integrations — that has procurement lead time.
ruth: From CS: AtlasHealth will accept a phased commitment if we give firm dates and a pilot SLA. They want the pilot to include audit logs and data isolation. Consider a 60-day pilot with reduced SLA but clear upgrade path.
maria: Sales would push for Aug 15. If engineering needs 8w+ for MVP, kickoff would have to be this week. Can we get a commitment to a kickoff and an MV P scope by COB tomorrow?
anya: I can negotiate kickoff but we must lock scope: MVP = Dedicated GPU pool + VPC peering + model pinning + monitoring dashboard + basic audit logs. Exclude HSM and enterprise SLA in MVP. Acceptance criteria (draft):
```
- Dedicated pool provisioned in customer region
- VPC peering established and verified (test traffic ok)
- Model pinned and serving at requested throughput (500 req/s sustained for 30m)
- p95 < 200ms under baseline workload
- Audit logs visible in Console and exported to S3
- Canary rollout for 1% of traffic, smoke tests green
```
If these pass, CS signs off and we start pilot.
dave: That acceptance list looks good. Action items: infra to create provisioning playbook, perf team to run load test, ops to prepare canary rollback. I need headcount/time — assigning 2 engs + 1 infra for 8w.
infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4821: AtlasHealth private onboarding playbook. Assigned to @tom.
maria: I'll ask AtlasHealth if they're ok with phased delivery and the MVP acceptance criteria. If they push back on HSM, we'll offer temporary customer-managed KMS + upgrade path.
tom: Also note: procurement for HSM vendor could slip timeline. If they require HSM by Aug 15, we should push for a contract clause or sign a limited feature SLA.
ruth: I'll prep a customer email template explaining phased rollout, pilot SLA, and expected dates. Also will offer bi-weekly checkpoints.
anya: Next steps: 1) engineering confirms resource commit by EOD tomorrow, 2) sales gets AtlasHealth sign-off on phased plan, 3) open design/implementation RFC for MVP. If any of these fail, we escalate to leadership for tradeoffs.
maria: sounds good. I'll ping Atlas and update the account doc. 
anya: tagging this as high-priority for roadmap negotiation. :rotating_light:
dave: +1. If we get the go, I'll create the sprint plan and link infra tickets.
maria: thx everyone — I'll post Atlas reply here as soon as I get it. :thumbsup:
